subject.title: fix(acp): keep completed run-mode sessions resumable

question: Should a completed parent-owned ACP run-mode one-shot remain resumable after its runtime process and task have reached terminal state, rather than being uniformly cleaned up?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally changing lifecycle semantics and persisted session state, not only correcting a local routing error; maintainers must choose whether that continuation capability is a supported long-term contract.

options.title: Adopt resumable one-shots
options.body: Accept retained verified ACP metadata as the continuation contract and merge after confirming the intended retention and explicit-close semantics.

options.title: Keep one-shots terminal
options.body: Preserve uniform terminal cleanup and decline this behavior, directing follow-ups to persistent ACP sessions or a separately designed continuation feature.

recommendation.title: Adopt resumable one-shots
recommendation.body: Accept retained verified ACP metadata as the continuation contract and merge after confirming the intended retention and explicit-close semantics.
